content.short: Clay Nation - a collection of 10,000 characters composed from +/- 100 handcrafted clay traits in 8 different categories.
content.description:
Clay Nation - a collection of 10,000 characters composed from +/- 100 handcrafted clay traits in 8 different categories. The traits are randomly assembled by algorithm creating wonderfully unique characters. Just like in the non-clay world, no two members of Clay Nation are the same. Bringing the party to the Cardano blockchain, each NFT character will also double as entry to Clay Nation - an exclusive members zone with a festival atmosphere.

Where art meets maths. Each trait was handmade by our animator, Joe. These traits have been randomised with an algorithm created by our in-house script wizard ,Vlad, to create the best 10,000 characters from billions of possible combinations. The characters were then safely re-homed on the blockchain.

No Clay Nation characters are identical twins and much like in the non clay world, are all unique. Rarity will be based on number of traits and their commonness within Clay Nation. A rarity table will be released as soon as possible.

‘Good vibes only’, Clay Nation is a space to celebrate unbounded individuality, to bask in positivity and to party in peace.
